preregistered.role: guardrail only: no regression and no unauthorized content; improvement is judged on the real annual reports (preparation/s4/real-reports/rerank)

base.must_reproduce: hybrid without a reranker returns, for all 47 questions, the sealed run's hits (id, version, source_hash, status) and error code; otherwise the reranker is not called and no rerank number is reported

reranker.passage: the full stored row content, including the [source] first line
reranker.score: raw logit, no sigmoid, used for ordering only
reranker.ties: equal scores keep the hybrid order
reranker.beyond_candidates: rows after the first 30 keep their hybrid order behind the reranked ones; nothing is dropped
reranker.revision: not pinned at registration (the model hub was unreachable from where this was written); each run records the snapshot commit it loaded

guardrail.unauthorized: all_query_leak 0/47, forbidden candidate rows 0, forbidden citation rows 0, reranker passages outside what the caller may read 0
guardrail.recall: core_content_recall_at_5 and macro_recall_at_5 not below the sealed hybrid run (0.9333 over 30 questions, 0.9459 over 37)
guardrail.exact_token: the exact-token slice not below the sealed hybrid run (1/1)
guardrail.unanswerable: unanswerable questions with a non-empty context not above the sealed hybrid run (1/3)

preregistered.sets_already_used: the 47 questions were used by the lexical baseline, the vector / hybrid comparison and the answerability check. No reranker was run on them before this registration.

reranker_settings.passage: the full stored row content, including the [source] first line

reranker_settings.ties: equal scores keep the hybrid order
reranker_settings.beyond_candidates: rows after the first 30 keep their hybrid order behind the reranked ones; nothing is dropped
reranker_settings.revision: not pinned at registration (the model hub was unreachable from where this was written); each run records the snapshot commit it loaded
